user.title: Crow Messenger
user.description: Set up Crow Messenger. There's nothing to fill in — add the Crow Messenger card to a dashboard, then open the card editor to choose each person's dashboard, notifications and how long messages are kept.

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Send a Crow Messenger message to one or more Home Assistant users.

to.name: To
to.description: Home Assistant user IDs or names to send to. More than one makes a group chat.

attachment.name: Attachment
attachment.description: Optional file to attach: a path inside an allowed folder (e.g. /config/www/doorbell.jpg) or a /local/… URL.

group_name.name: Group name
group_name.description: Optional name for the group chat when sending to more than one person.

actions.name: Buttons
actions.description: Optional buttons under the message, e.g. ["Unlock", "Ignore"] or [{"title": "Unlock", "action": "UNLOCK_DOOR"}]. Tapping one (in the card or the notification) fires the crow_messenger_action event with who tapped it.

post.name: Post to the Feed
post.description: Post in the Crow Messenger Feed, optionally with photos or videos. Posts as Home Assistant from an automation, or as the person who ran the action.

attachment.name: Photos or videos
attachment.description: Optional photo or video files to include: paths inside an allowed folder or /local/… URLs. One, or a list.

to.name: Who can see it
to.description: Optional: everyone (the default), or Home Assistant users, names or person entities who can see it.

group.name: Group
group.description: Optional: the name of a Feed group to post in instead. Only its members see it.

background.name: Background
background.description: Optional coloured background for a short post with no photos: accent, sunset, ocean, forest, berry, night, rose or gold.

send_email.name: Send email
send_email.description: Sends an email from one of the Crow Messenger Email accounts.

account.name: From account
account.description: The account to send from: its email address or its name in Crow Messenger Email.

to.name: To
to.description: Who to send to. Separate several addresses with commas.

bcc.name: Bcc
bcc.description: Copied to, without the others seeing.

message.name: Message
message.description: The email, as plain text. The account's signature is added.

html.name: HTML
html.description: The email as HTML instead of plain text (no signature is added).

attachments.name: Attachments
attachments.description: Files to attach, from /config/www (/local/...), /media (/media/local/...) or another allowed folder.

send_at.name: Send at
send_at.description: Send it later, at this time, instead of straight away.

buttons.name: Buttons
buttons.description: Buttons in the email, each with a title and an action (and optionally a colour). Tapping one fires a crow_email_action event with that action, once. Each button works for two weeks.

poll.name: Voting buttons
poll.description: Two to eight choices. People vote by tapping one and sending the reply that opens; each vote fires a crow_email_vote event.

read_receipt.name: Ask for a read receipt
read_receipt.description: Asks the person's mail app to send a receipt when they open the email (they can choose not to).

mark_email_as_read.name: Mark email as read
mark_email_as_read.description: Marks an email as read (or unread).

account.name: Account
account.description: The account's email address (or its name in Crow Messenger Email).

folder.name: Folder
folder.description: The folder the email is in. INBOX unless you say otherwise.

uid.name: Email
uid.description: The email's uid, from the crow_email_received event (trigger.event.data.uid).

message_id.name: Message-ID
message_id.description: Or find the email by its Message-ID header.

all.name: Every email
all.description: Mark every email in the folder.

archive_email.name: Archive email
archive_email.description: Moves an email to the account's Archive folder.

account.name: Account
account.description: The account's email address (or its name in Crow Messenger Email).

folder.name: Folder
folder.description: The folder the email is in. INBOX unless you say otherwise.

uid.name: Email
uid.description: The email's uid, from the crow_email_received event (trigger.event.data.uid).

message_id.name: Message-ID
message_id.description: Or find the email by its Message-ID header.

move_email.name: Move email to folder
move_email.description: Moves an email to another folder.

account.name: Account
account.description: The account's email address (or its name in Crow Messenger Email).

folder.name: Folder
folder.description: The folder the email is in. INBOX unless you say otherwise.

uid.name: Email
uid.description: The email's uid, from the crow_email_received event (trigger.event.data.uid).

message_id.name: Message-ID
message_id.description: Or find the email by its Message-ID header.

to_folder.name: To folder
to_folder.description: The folder to move it to, by name.

flag_email.name: Flag email
flag_email.description: Flags an email (or removes the flag).

account.name: Account
account.description: The account's email address (or its name in Crow Messenger Email).

folder.name: Folder
folder.description: The folder the email is in. INBOX unless you say otherwise.

uid.name: Email
uid.description: The email's uid, from the crow_email_received event (trigger.event.data.uid).

message_id.name: Message-ID
message_id.description: Or find the email by its Message-ID header.

refresh_email.name: Check for new email
refresh_email.description: Checks for new mail now and updates the sensors.

account.name: Account
account.description: Just this account. Leave empty for all of them.

update_email_badge.name: Update the app badge's email number
update_email_badge.description: Brings the red number on the Home Assistant app's icon up to date for the person who owns an account, optionally adding a number of your own (for example parcels on their way). Needs App Icon Badge turned on in the card editor.

account.name: Account
account.description: Any of the person's email accounts, by email address or description.

extra.name: Extra
extra.description: A number added to the badge, kept until you change it. Use 0 to stop adding one.
